Curve25519 syscall handlers for point validation, group ops, and multiscalar multiplication.

# Purpose
This file implements Solana VM syscalls for Curve25519 operations. It provides entry points for point validation, group operations, and multi-scalar multiplication on the `edwards` and `ristretto` forms of Curve25519. The functions translate VM addresses to host memory, charge compute units with the proper cost for each operation, validate input data, and write results back to VM memory. The code also handles invalid curve and operation values with the `abort_on_invalid_curve` feature flag, which can return `FD_VM_SYSCALL_ERR_INVALID_ATTRIBUTE` instead of a soft error.

The main public functions are [`fd_vm_syscall_sol_curve_validate_point`](<#fd_vm_syscall_sol_curve_validate_point>), [`fd_vm_syscall_sol_curve_group_op`](<#fd_vm_syscall_sol_curve_group_op>), and [`fd_vm_syscall_sol_curve_multiscalar_mul`](<#fd_vm_syscall_sol_curve_multiscalar_mul>). The file also defines helper functions [`multi_scalar_mul_edwards`](<#multi_scalar_mul_edwards>) and [`multi_scalar_mul_ristretto`](<#multi_scalar_mul_ristretto>) to process batched multi-scalar multiplication without dynamic allocation. These helpers validate scalars, decompress points, call the lower-level curve math functions from `fd_ed25519` and `fd_ristretto255`, and combine batch results into one output point.
